remarks: Welcome to 22181 Malibu Lane, ideally located south of Banning Avenue in Newport West, one of Huntington Beach’s most desirable beachside neighborhoods. Set on a quiet interior lot backing to Talbert Channel, this single-level home offers big-sky sunsets, no rear neighbors, and refreshing ocean breezes. A future second-story addition could capture spectacular whitewater ocean and wetland views. Inside, beautiful bamboo flooring flows through an open and inviting layout, highlighted by a large picture window overlooking the private front courtyard.
